fields.label: DocType
fields.description: Applies to every report whose Reference DocType is this. Filled in automatically when a Report is chosen.

fields.label: Report
fields.description: Optional. Restrict this rule to a single report. Leave empty to cover every report on the DocType above.

fields.label: Roles Allowed To See
fields.description: Users with any of these roles still see the fields. Leave empty to hide from everyone except Administrator.

fields.options:
Matching columns are removed from the report response on the server, before it is sent. This covers the report view, the CSV/Excel export and background export jobs. It is not a client-side hide, so the values never reach the browser.

Target either a single Report or a DocType. Set Report to hide columns in that one report only. Leave it empty and the rule covers every report whose Reference DocType matches. For example VIN Stock Report reports on Serial No, so a rule built against Stock Entry will not affect it. Use Preview For User to see which reports a rule covers.

Computed report columns (ones built in the report's own SQL or Python, such as total_valuation) can be typed straight into the Fields table — they do not have to exist on the DocType. Chart series and summary tiles built on a hidden column are dropped too.

List View, Report View and the REST API are already covered by Perm Level Rule, which Frappe enforces in the database query layer.
